text: DeepSeek Harness Predictions 是面向 DSH Web 的预测消息插件：助手回复后，它读取近期用户与助手文字并调用所选模型，在空输入框上显示下一句灰字建议。用户可按 Tab 填入草稿、检查后自行发送，也可双击右箭头手动生成；插件还支持跟随会话模型或单独选择模型、状态提示和用量统计。适合希望更快接续对话、同时保留发送控制权的 DSH 用户。真实预测默认关闭；启用后会向所选模型服务发送对话文本。自定义模型连接需填写服务地址、模型 ID 和 API Key。

DeepSeek Harness Predictions shows a next-message suggestion as gray text in the DSH Web composer. Press Tab to add it to your draft, then review and send it yourself; double-press → to request one manually. Predictions are off by default; custom models need an API URL, model ID, and API key.
想让 DSH 根据刚才的对话，给我下一句回复建议。
有没有办法把模型预测的下一句先放进输入草稿让我确认？
Suggest a likely next message from my recent assistant conversation.
DeepSeek Harness Predictions 的功能「输入框下一句建议」：助手回复后，根据近期对话生成灰字建议；Tab 可将建议填入草稿，发送由用户决定。
DeepSeek Harness Predictions 的功能「手动预测与缓存恢复」：空输入框快速双击右箭头可生成建议；接受后清空草稿可恢复本轮缓存，不必再次请求模型。
DeepSeek Harness Predictions 使用最多近期 8 条用户与助手文字作为预测上下文，并发送给所选模型服务；启用真实预测可能产生服务商费用。
DeepSeek Harness Predictions 的自定义模型连接需 API Key；密钥经 DSH 凭据服务保存为引用，预测时读取后用于请求自定义服务。

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · DeepSeek Harness Predictions：简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

**预测你的下一句话，Tab 填入，确认后发送。**

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供输入框灰字建议。助手回复后，插件根据近期对话预测你可能说的下一句话；需要时按一下填入草稿，发送仍由你决定。

`@kkucodes/dsh-predictions` · `1.0.0` · 独立插件 · 不修改 DSH 本体

[开始使用](#开始使用) · [操作键位](#操作键位) · [完整指南](./docs/README.md) · [更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions/issues)

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 用起来是什么样：- **对话接着走**：自动生成下一句建议，也可切换为仅手动，在空输入框快速按两次 → 生成。
- **建议可以找回来**：接受后撤销至空草稿，或清空自己输入的文字，可恢复本轮建议，不重复调用模型。
- **预测模型独立选择**：跟随会话模型、选择宿主已配置的模型，或接入自定义 OpenAI 兼容服务，不改变主聊天模型。
- **状态和用量看得见**：模型选择旁显示预测状态；可查看本插件的 Token 用量，并按自填单价估算费用。

插件只在空输入框中提供建议。有草稿、附件、引用、排队消息或会话正在运行时会跳过，不覆盖你的输入，也不自动发送消息或启动 Agent。

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 兼容范围：| 环境 | 当前验证情况 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.3` · Edge | 1.0.0 安装包主流程已验证 |
| DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2` · Chrome | 补充运行验证，范围见[兼容性说明](./docs/project-knowledge/knowledge/domains/predictions/stability.md) |
| 独立 Electron 桌面窗口 | 尚未验收 |

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 1. 安装插件：在终端执行，直接安装到 DSH Web：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions
```

也可以在 DSH 侧边栏打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，填写 `github:KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions` 并安装。安装后确认插件已启用。

仓库携带预编译产物，安装时无需本地构建或额外构建授权。离线安装包和版本说明见 [Releases](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions/releases)。

<details>
<summary>已有源码？在本地构建安装包</summary>

需要 Node.js 24.9 或更新版本。在本项目根目录执行：

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 1. 安装插件：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts', { recursive: true })"
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts

得到 `artifacts/kkucodes-dsh-predictions-1.0.0.tgz`。先构建再打包，不能直接把源码文件夹或任意开源仓库当作已构建插件安装。详细环境见[开发说明](./docs/development.md)。

</details>

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 2. 开启预测：1. 打开 `@kkucodes/dsh-predictions` 的设置，开启 **启用预测消息**。
2. 进入至少有一轮正常完成回复的会话，等待建议，或在空输入框快速按两次 →。
3. 按 Tab 填入草稿，检查内容后自行发送。

**真实预测默认关闭，开启后模型请求可能产生费用。** 想先体验操作，可在「更多设置 → 效果测试」使用固定测试句；效果测试不调用模型，开启时暂停真实预测。

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 操作键位：| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 空输入框中按 Tab | 立即填入已有建议 |
| 空输入框中按一次 → | 约等待 300 毫秒后填入已有建议 |
| 空输入框中快速按两次 → | 没有建议时，手动生成一次 |
| 撤销至空草稿，或清空文字 | 恢复本轮缓存建议，不新增请求 |
| Esc | 丢弃本轮建议 |

已有建议时，按两次 → 会保留原建议，不重新生成；已有草稿时保持原光标操作。新建空会话尚无可预测的对话内容，不会生成建议。

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 模型由你选择：默认跟随当前会话，也可为预测单独选模型。自定义连接支持 **非流式 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容格式**，可设置 API 基础地址、Key、模型名称，以及可选输出长度和文本、数字、布尔、JSON 参数。

自定义 Key 由 DSH 的公开凭据服务保存，不写入普通插件设置，界面不回显已存密钥。连接测试会发送一次请求，测试成功后仍需点击「保存并使用」。具体配置见[使用指南](./docs/README.md#选择预测模型)。

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 使用前了解：- 请求超过 **12 秒**会超时，失败不自动重试；可查看状态提示，再明确手动重试。
- 刚执行本地命令的会话中，首次填入可能无法通过 Ctrl+Z 撤销，可选中后删除。
- 真实系统输入法候选词窗口、Electron 和跨设备实时同步尚未完整验收。

更多问题见[故障处理](./docs/README.md#常见问题)。

**Predict your next message. Press Tab to fill it in. Send when you're ready.**

Inline suggestions for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). After the assistant replies, the plugin uses recent conversation context to suggest what you might say next. Accept it into your draft, review it, and decide whether to send.

`@kkucodes/dsh-predictions` · `1.0.0` · Independent plugin · No DSH modifications

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · DeepSeek Harness Predictions：[Get started](#get-started) · [Keyboard controls](#keyboard-controls) · [User guide](./docs/README.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions/issues)

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · What it does：- **Keep the conversation moving.** Generate suggestions automatically, or switch to manual-only mode and press → twice quickly in an empty input.
- **Bring suggestions back.** Undo acceptance to an empty draft, or clear what you typed, to restore the cached suggestion without another model call.
- **Choose a prediction model separately.** Follow the conversation model, select a model configured in DSH, or use a custom OpenAI-compatible service. Your chat model stays the same.
- **See status and usage.** A status indicator sits beside the model selector. View this plugin's token usage and estimate costs using prices you enter.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · What it does：Suggestions are available only in an empty input. Existing drafts, attachments, references, queued messages or a running conversation prevent prediction. The plugin does not overwrite your input, send messages automatically or start an Agent.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 1. Install the plugin：Run this command in a terminal to install directly into DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions
```

Alternatively, open **插件 → 添加插件** (Plugins → Add plugin) in the DSH sidebar, enter `github:KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions`, and install it. Make sure the plugin is enabled afterward.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 1. Install the plugin：The repository includes prebuilt files, so installation requires no local build or additional build approval. Offline packages and release notes are available from [Releases](https://github.com/KKUCODES/deepseek-harness-predictions/releases).

<details>
<summary>Have the source? Build the package locally</summary>

Use Node.js 24.9 or newer. Run these commands from the project root:

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 1. Install the plugin：```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts', { recursive: true })"
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination artifacts

The result is `artifacts/kkucodes-dsh-predictions-1.0.0.tgz`. Build before packaging; a source folder or arbitrary open-source repository is not automatically an installable DSH plugin. See the [development guide (Chinese)](./docs/development.md).

</details>

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · 2. Enable predictions：**Real predictions are off by default. Enabling them may incur model-provider charges.** To try the interaction first, use **更多设置 → 效果测试** (More settings → Effect test). It displays fixed text without calling a model and pauses real prediction while enabled.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Keyboard controls：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab in an empty input | Fill the draft with the existing suggestion immediately |
| Press → once in an empty input | Accept the existing suggestion after roughly 300 ms |
| Press → twice quickly in an empty input | Generate once if no suggestion exists |
| Undo to an empty draft, or clear the text | Restore the cached suggestion without another request |
| Esc | Dismiss the suggestion for this turn |

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Keyboard controls：Pressing → twice keeps an existing suggestion rather than regenerating it. With a nonempty draft, normal cursor behavior is preserved. A new empty conversation has no context to predict from.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Your choice of model：Predictions follow the current conversation model by default, or you can choose a separate model. Custom connections support **non-streaming OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible APIs**, with a base URL, API key, model ID, optional output limit, and string, number, boolean or JSON parameters.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Your choice of model：Custom keys are stored through DSH's public credentials service, not ordinary plugin settings. Saved keys are not displayed. Connection testing sends one request; a successful test still requires **保存并使用** (Save and use). See [model configuration (Chinese)](./docs/README.md#选择预测模型).

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Costs and privacy：Your selected provider charges for prediction and connection-test requests. The plugin has no daily call limit; turn it off or choose manual-only mode when appropriate. Accepting, undoing, restoring or reading a cached suggestion does not trigger another model call.

Usage statistics cover this plugin only. Cost estimates use prices you enter; your provider's bill is authoritative. Requests without complete usage information are marked for reconciliation, not treated as free.

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Costs and privacy：By default, prediction uses up to **8 recent user/assistant text messages**, sent to your selected model service. Conversation system instructions, tool logs, attachments and reasoning content are excluded. [Context and privacy details (Chinese)](./docs/README.md#对话内容与隐私)

@kkucodes/dsh-predictions README · Known limits：- Requests time out after **12 seconds** and are not retried automatically. Check the status details before explicitly retrying.
- Immediately after a local command, the first accepted suggestion may not support Ctrl+Z undo; select and delete it if needed.
- Real system IME candidate windows, Electron and cross-device real-time synchronization are not fully verified.

See [troubleshooting (Chinese)](./docs/README.md#常见问题) for more.
